questions.prompt: Which operator accesses a member through a pointer to an object?
What lets several functions share a name but differ in parameter lists?
questions.explanation: Overloading resolves the call at compile time using the argument types.

questions.prompt: Which smart pointer models sole ownership of a heap object?
questions.explanation: unique_ptr cannot be copied and deletes the object when it goes out of scope.

questions.prompt: Why should a base class meant for polymorphic use have a virtual destructor?
options: So deleting through a base pointer runs the derived destructor
questions.explanation: Without it, deleting a derived object via a base pointer is undefined behaviour.
